name: The Unlanded
descriptionSeed: The pure pole: those who never arrive anywhere at all. The Unlanded have kept walking so long they have stopped being able to stop, and they are not lost — they are past arrival as a category. Meeting them on a road is one of the loneliest experiences available to a person.
encounterFlavor: The Unlanded, who cannot stop and are not unhappy; someone who joined them a year ago and does not recognize you; the pull to just keep going.
questSeeds: A Walker's whole family has gone Unlanded and one of them left a message
Somebody has found where the Unlanded are GOING, and it is somewhere
worldPosNote: Deep expression of its Reach — placed near the equator on the the_open_reach bearing. (SNG-180: authored position — WHERE it sits. Independent of axisVector, which is WHAT it is; a bastion is where the two disagree.)
appearance: A column of people and carts moving across open country, strung out to the horizon in both directions. No camp, no fires, no halt. Ruts behind them, unbroken ground ahead.

carriage.why: It does not halt, and the pace says so: 325 miles in 28 days is a column making twelve miles a day, every day, forever. Where the Long Span is a settlement that moves between stops, this has never had one — the circuit is where it PASSES, not where it stays, and a player who reaches a waypoint on the wrong day finds ruts and nothing else.

_carriage_20260914: ⛔ SNG-591, Erik 2026-09-14: 'the Horizon-Walkers have a settlement called the Long Span… it moves. That would be a good use of the new carriage capability.' ⛑ THREE PLACES MOVE, NOT ONE — the Long Span, the Unlanded and the Wend all say so in their own prose and all three sat still. ⚠️ A LOCATION HAS NO SECOND GRAPH TO MOVE ALONG AND DOES NOT NEED ONE: `connections` already names where each goes, and all 138 locations carry `worldPos`, so `voyagePosition`'s arithmetic works on a place today without a new field. ⛔ WHAT IS NEW IS THE SHAPE: a holding makes a VOYAGE from A to B and arrives; a settlement keeps a CIRCUIT and comes round. `daysPerCircuit` divided across the legs gives the leg it is on for any world day, which is the same lerp `voyagePosition` already does. ⬜ NOTHING READS `location.carriage` YET — specced for CCode, and dead until it is wired.
